title: Growth-limiting intracellular metabolites in yeast growing under diverse nutrient limitations
selection_reason: Hackett 2016 explicitly reuses these prior-culture metabolomics observations. This is an ancestor to audit, not an independent Hackett validation dataset.

primary_article.permissions_text: Copyright 2010 by The American Society for Cell Biology
primary_article.license_status: Europe PMC marks the article open access and serves its supplements. No explicit reusable-data license was verified in the inspected XML permissions; do not substitute an assumed CC license.

MATERIALS AND METHODS / Normalization and Clustering

public_archive.checksum_note: Archive packaging may change; the individually decompressed member digests below are the stable source bindings to verify.
public_archive.reason: Contains all conditions, references, published transformations and source outcomes. Retrieved into memory for schema/identity verification only.

culture_metadata.nominal_design: Five limiting nutrients crossed with five dilution settings; nominal rates approximately 0.05, 0.11, 0.16, 0.22 and 0.30 per hour.
culture_metadata.temperature_status: Not verified in the inspected source methods; no default yeast growth temperature assumed.
culture_metadata.vessel: 500 mL Sixfors chemostats, 300 mL working volume
culture_metadata.aeration: 400 rpm; source reports five standard liters/minute humidified air
culture_metadata.medium: Defined mineral medium adapted from Brauer et al. 2008; complete medium recipe cited as Supplemental Table S4. Do not equate media solely from a nutrient-limit label.
culture_metadata.biological_replicate_unit: A complete chemostat culture and all its sampled extracts; four technical samples per experimental condition are not four independent biological cultures.
culture_metadata.reference_dependencies: Each experimental sample was paired to two phosphorus-limited reference samples. Published processing matches analysis date and filter/pellet extraction method. Preserve those shared references in any dependency graph.
culture_metadata.compartment: Whole-cell extract, normalized using total cellular volume; not compartment-resolved cytosol.
culture_metadata.relationship_to_hackett: Prior culture set. Nominal limitation/growth matching is not simultaneous E/substrate/reaction-rate matching.

schema.source_cell_locator: Archive member SHA256 + one-based text line + exact column header + first-column sample identifier; technical fields retained as source values.

verified_files.measurement_type: LC-MS/MS normalized ion-count measurements, not molar concentration and not enzyme activity
verified_files.unit: Ion counts normalized by total cell volume extracted and extraction-solvent volume; detector-scale response
verified_files.preprocessing_lineage: Raw ion counts -> cell/extract-volume normalization -> source lower-quantitation-floor handling. The paper describes replacing absent/low normalized signal by a fixed floor; this is not an uncensored raw peak-intensity table.
verified_files.absolute_concentration_gate: Requires analyte-specific calibrated standards/reference measurements and an explicit adapter. Do not treat normalized ion counts or the aggregate metabolite names as cytosolic mM.
verified_files.feature_policy: All 106 available measurement columns are listed, including unresolved aggregates and original misspellings. This list does not identify the paper-selected regulators or regulatory directions. Covariate eligibility must be predeclared using identity/assay semantics, not fitted performance.

verified_files.measurement_type: Published processed relative-metabolomics matrix, not raw instrument data
verified_files.normalization_warning: Publication heat-map processing uses phosphorus-reference ratios, log2 transformation and mean-centering over conditions. Do not use a published globally normalized matrix as fold-independent training data without an exact table-specific derivation audit.

verified_files.measurement_type: Assay analyte identity, acquisition settings and source exclusion rationale
verified_files.reason: Only reviewed identity/assay-metadata projections may later be allowlisted; no raw workbook handoff.

verified_files.measurement_type: Extraction-method comparison workbook; mixes replicate signals and statistical comparison columns

schema.layout: Repeated nutrient-block headers; not a flat single-header table
schema.first_block_summary_row: Row 4 alternates average/stdev in columns A:J
schema.unit_note: The worksheet labels cell volume in fL, while the paper's normalization example uses pL. Preserve declared source units and apply an explicit volume conversion, not a guessed numerical scale.
schema.source_cell_locator: Member SHA256 + exact worksheet + A1 cell address + nutrient block

verified_files.measurement_type: Condition summaries of culture/cell-volume and extracellular measurements, including reported standard deviations

additional_access_probe.blocker: TLS certificate was not valid for growthrate.princeton.edu. Certificate verification was not disabled. The official Europe PMC supplemental archive provides an accessible public alternative.

export_decision.reason: Current protocol is for measured Cdc19 intracellular flux, not standalone metabolomics. No eligible measured target, cross-culture joint map, independent support or approved split exists.
